name: God of dragon minions
slug: Unnamed god worshipped at a shrine in the white dragon's hoard.
description: An unnamed god of dragon minions. A small shrine in the white dragon's hoard—a statuette, a brazier, and an altar—was dedicated to this god.

log.summary: Dana's notes from the white dragon hoard, dated November 3 of the previous year, record a small shrine with a statuette, a brazier, and an altar dedicated to this unnamed god of dragon minions. No name or further identity is recovered.
notes: Unnamed god. The white dragon hoard included a small shrine with a statuette, a brazier, and an altar dedicated to a god of dragon minions.
